output.headline: Vague 'waiting too long' escalation trigger causes agent to hand off routine, in-SLA refund status questions to humans.
what_happens: Customer asks a routine status question mentioning elapsed time.
Refund_status tool returns processing state with SLA not breached.
Agent ignores the objective SLA data and matches the subjective 'waiting too long' phrasing instead.
Agent escalates to a human with a fabricated reason, never answering the customer.
output.why_it_matters: Every in-SLA status inquiry mentioning time hits this same ungated clause, causing 70 traces to escalate needlessly, tripling handling time versus peers.
output.fix_in_one_line: Replace the subjective escalation trigger with objective SLA-breach/state checks and add an explicit in-SLA answer path.

notes: Captured from a live run triggered in the browser.
